shellCommands.command: ls -R app __agent_eval__ && cat app/*.tsx app/*.ts 2>/dev/null; cat next.config.ts tsconfig.json
cat node_modules/next/package.json | head -20 && echo "--- cache exports ---" && cat node_modules/next/cache.d.ts 2>/dev/null; cat node_modules/next/cache.js 2>/dev/null | head -40
npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | tail -20; echo "=== BUILD ==="; npm run build 2>&1 | tail -40

(npx next start -p 3111 > /tmp/next.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 6; curl -s localhost:3111 -o /tmp/page.html; grep -o "Hello world" /tmp/page.html | head -2; echo "--- action ids ---"; grep -oE '\\?"\$\$id\\?":\\?"[a-f0-9]{40,}' /tmp/page.html | head -3; grep -oE '[a-f0-9]{40,}' /tmp/page.html | sort -u | head -5

cd /tmp && curl -s -X POST localhost:3111/ \
  -F '$ACTION_REF_1=' \
  -F '$ACTION_1:0={"id":"607e3eb8a8431e82b78355b0ff9b69769a7d98db24","bound":"$@1"}' \
  -F '$ACTION_1:1=[null]' \
  -F '$ACTION_KEY=k0c684f3c32ad373ec47ea18e0913a6ea' \
  -F 'title=Fresh post from smoke test' \
  -F 'content=should appear immediately' \
  -o /tmp/post-response.html -w "status=%{http_code}\n"
echo "--- new post present in the SAME response? ---"
grep -c "Fresh post from smoke test" /tmp/post-response.html
echo "--- next GET (fresh cache?) ---"
curl -s localhost:3111/ | grep -c "Fresh post from smoke test"
pkill -f "next start" ; pkill -f "next-server" ; sleep 1; git status --short
